outcome_evidence: The upper drawer is initially closed (frame 0, left_ego_image). The robot approaches and engages its handle (frames 83–110, wrist_image), then pulls the drawer outward, exposing its side and an opening behind the front (frames 120–165, image and left_ego_image). The gripper releases and withdraws (frames 166–190, wrist_image); the drawer remains visibly extended through frame 399 in image. No failed acquisition, unintended object displacement, or damage is established.
